description: Given a list of changed source files, returns which test files are affected — directly or transitively through the import graph. Use to answer: which tests should I run after this code change?

changed_files.description: List of changed file paths (absolute or relative to project_root)

git_diff.description: Raw output of `git diff --name-only` — newline-separated file paths. Use instead of changed_files when piping git output directly.

project_root.description: Absolute path to the TypeScript project root (must contain tsconfig.json)

name: get_affected_tests
